This small maize plot is close to my house, so I will work it myself with my family. I will try to buy a little NPK and urea from the agro-dealer if the subsidy comes, because maize does not yield well without fertilizer on our tired soils here in the middle belt. I will also spread some goat and chicken droppings from the compound since it costs me nothing. I cannot afford to irrigate and I will plant the seed I saved from last year, intercropped with cowpea as we always do.
